findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "api_access_buy" references sensitive artifacts (authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Buy 1000 basic data reads for US$0.10, valid for 30 days. Same pass in retries recovers the same purchase. No automatic renewal. OCR, AI, documents and delivery…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: contact · Private data: cep, contact, api_access, api_access_buy, get_api_x402_cnpj_by_cnpj · Public sink: proximo, contact, api_access_buy.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: contact · Private data: cep, contact, api_access, api_access_buy, get_api_x402_cnpj_by_cnpj · Public sink: proximo, contact, api_access_buy

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

detail: Tool "cep" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
